description: This file defines generic activator classes for creating instances of types T, including default implementations for reference and value types. It employs reflection and dynamic method generation to instantiate objects.

classes.name: DefaultActivator`1
classes.description: An abstract generic activator class providing a mechanism to create instances of type T using reflection and dynamic methods.

classes.name: DefaultReferenceTypeActivator`1
classes.description: A sealed class derived from DefaultActivator for reference types, implementing the Create method to instantiate reference type objects.

classes.name: DefaultValueTypeActivator`1
classes.description: A sealed class derived from DefaultActivator for value types, implementing the Create method to instantiate value type objects.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: A private static method that attempts to generate a delegate for instantiating type T via a dynamic method, returning null if no parameterless constructor exists.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Abstract method for creating an instance of type T.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Overridden method in DefaultReferenceTypeActivator to create an instance of a reference type T.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Overridden method in DefaultValueTypeActivator to create an instance of a value type T.
